summary: Reitar Logtech Holdings Limited furnished a Form 6-K reporting completion of a US$5.5 million private placement of Class A ordinary shares. Under six subscription agreements dated October 2, 2026 with six non-U.S. purchasers, the company issued 2,750,000 Class A shares at US$2.00 per share on October 14, 2026, on a post-consolidation basis following the September 3, 2026 25-for-1 share consolidation. Proceeds are for general working capital. Shares were sold under Regulation S and are unregistered; post-issuance there are 6,434,288 Class A and 672,400 Class B shares outstanding. This is a routine financing, not a special situation.
